title: Multi-framework UI system
summary: A UI component system for a company with dozens of applications on different stacks (PHP, .NET, Java, React, Angular) and vertical-specific design lines.
highlights: Framework-agnostic Web Components on Lit, plus a sister design-token CSS library that exports only the CSS each page uses.
React and Angular wrappers so each team adopts it in its own stack.
Roughly 2x features per sprint (team story points) and near-complete mobile support in apps that had none.
An MCP server that tells LLMs and AI tooling which components to use.

title: Smartdrive frontend migration
summary: Partial migration of the customer-facing screens of a long-lived .NET Framework 4 platform to Web Components and React.
highlights: Led the analysis, product conversations, first components and custom adaptations such as charts.
Team of 14 over the first 6 months, fixing years-old bugs and updating rendering-engine dependencies.
Released in one go with zero production defects, with better load time and accessibility (Lighthouse).

title: BMV bond-trading frontend
summary: A from-scratch platform for new clients to buy government bonds on the Mexican Stock Exchange.
highlights: Defined the architecture with the tech lead and built the entire frontend in 6 months.
Angular with Clean Architecture so more modules could be added without rewrites.
RxJS, WebSockets and Server-Sent Events to show live price swings of stocks and bonds.

title: Arlo iOS app: MVVM with SwiftUI
summary: Joined a security app's iOS team as an emergency developer and proposed an architecture to fix slowness caused by duplicated API calls between screens.
highlights: Prototyped MVVM with SwiftUI and the base services, with fewer crashes on map elements and centralized permission requests.
Approved by Arlo's leads and implemented by their internal team.
Time to a useful screen dropped from over 10 seconds to about 5.

title: 3Sixty microfrontends and checkout
summary: A B2B room-booking platform for large companies, built by three teams of about ten people.
highlights: Proposed a Next.js monorepo of microfrontends so booking, checkout and search deploy independently and share components.
Proposed a Factory pattern for checkout: one URL for every payment variation, with lazy-loaded steps by role, hotel or client configuration.

title: Silverlight to Angular migration
summary: Phased migration of a construction-sector CRM, from simple modules to project planning and machinery organization.
highlights: Built a custom Angular RouterModule extension for browser-tab-like navigation that keeps every screen's state in memory.
